note: Since the 04E cutover kg runs on Lisp-2 fe and matches Emacs: setq writes the value cell and defun the function cell, so (setq f 7) then (defun f () 9) coexist -- (list ... f (f)) is (7 9), f's value surviving defun, which only changed its function cell. Pre-cut kg shared one per-symbol value cell (fe.c: a symbol was (name . value)), defun clobbered the plain value, and kg answered ((lambda nil 9) 9).
